items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on dislocated left elbow; will consult experts. Marcus Mariota expected to start Sunday vs Seattle.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow; team protocol imaging
items.opportunity: Mariota streamer; Commanders pass-catchers with new QB

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson said Caleb Williams is week-to-week with hamstring injury after MRI; expectation he will likely miss some time. Same left hamstring he injured in college Dec 2022.
items.why: Hamstring pull; coach comments and MRI
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks possible; Tyson Bagent starts
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers volume shift under Bagent

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
items.implication: McConkey playable; Harvey out opens Coleman

items.text: GTD: Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) optimism/flak jacket; Puka Nacua (hip). Not expected: RJ Harvey (hamstring). Expected: Chris Olave, Joe Burrow, others. OUT: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Michael Pittman (foot).
items.implication: Flowers/Pittman out; McConkey/Nacua monitor; Olave/Burrow in

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through two weeks opportunities Bucky 36 vs Gainwell 12. Sean Tucker active no snaps.
items.implication: Bucky clear lead back; Gainwell limited

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble history + role need with Brown out

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27% and 38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points. RIDE OR DIE.
items.why: High target share and expected points

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger; hope is minor injury. He played through it.
49ers HC Kyle Shanahan said Mike Evans’ hip injury not believed serious; could have returned in fourth quarter if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.

Sunday injuries watching: Caleb Williams (hamstring), Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Jonathon Brooks (groin), Rico Dowdle (toe), JK Dobbins (hamstring), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip not serious), others.
items.implication: Multiple key players status TBD Week 3

items.opportunity: Isaiah Likely / Mark Andrews targets up
If out, TE/WR depth up (Whittington doubtful)

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps, David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29-of-67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.implication: Gadsden TE opportunity if Njoku/Kolar limited
items.opportunity: Routes and snaps for backup TE

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr down to 0.53 yards per route run this season. Only a few WRs worse.
